source.author: ov
source.text: Victa iacet pietas, et virgo caede madentis, ultima caelestum terras Astraea reliquit.
source.text_original: Victa iacet pietas, et virgo caede madentis, / ultima caelestum terras Astraea reliquit.
source.text_english: Piety lies vanquished, and the virgin Astraea, last of the heavenly ones, left the earth soaked with slaughter.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: quaenam aligeris secat anguibus auras caede madens?
reuse.text_original: quaenam aligeris secat anguibus auras / caede madens?
reuse.text_english: What one, dripping with slaughter, cleaves the air with winged serpents?
